evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reports 443.0 °C, markedly inconsistent with the other column temperatures of 63.3–75.5 °C.
T701 remains anomalously high at 446.4 °C while all other measured temperatures are 63.3–74.3 °C; the discrepancy persists throughout the observations.
System pressure is 500.0 mbar, differential pressures are 0.6 and 2.7 mbar, and both level switches remain at 1; no corresponding pressure excursion is evident.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and signal-scaling checks, and protocol temperature limits are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a measurement fault. No composition measurement or target specification is supplied; reflux and distillate flow instruments are not installed.
